'''Meatlump Mono''' was a [[Virus|viral]] infection transmitted through the act of kissing another [[Species/Legends|beings]] [[Mouth/Legends|mouth]]. [[Drooler]]s working for the [[Meatlumps|Meatlump Gang]] were known to occasionally transmit it to customers while operating a kissing booth within the confines of their [[Meatlump Hideout|sewer hideout]] beneath the streets of [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]].<ref name="SWG:MTP" />

==Behind the scenes==
Meatlump Mono was a viral infection which weakened players in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:MTP" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> It was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Meatlumps Theme Park|Meatlumps Theme Park]]", introduced with "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 10|Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King]]," released on [[June 19]], [[2008]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67812&month=062008|text=Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King}}</ref>
